Name: Eliphelet, Son of David
Summary: Eliphelet, son of David, was born at Jerusalem and named last among the sons born to him there. He is distinct from Eliphelet son of Ahasbai, one of the mighty men.
KeyStory: Eliphelet son of David was born at Jerusalem, sharing a name with one of his father's warriors.
LifeLesson: A king's son and a king's warrior can share a name and a lifetime.
